phrases.latin: Hīc harēna nigra est, nōn flāva.
phrases.english: The sand here is black, not yellow.

phrases.latin: Harēna nigra sōle calet; nōlī nūdīs pedibus īre.
phrases.english: The black sand is hot in the sun; don’t walk barefoot.

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
